name: __CredentialId__M365
label: M365 Excel Credential
description: The M365 Excel credential containing valid tenant ID, client ID, and client secret which is used to authenticate API requests.

name: DriveAndItemId
label: Drive and Item ID
description: The Drive ID and Item ID of the Excel file in OneDrive or SharePoint (format: driveId/items/itemId).

name: WorksheetName
label: Worksheet Name
description: The name of the worksheet to set color value to specific range in the Excel file.

name: RangeAddress
label: Range Address
description: Set color to specific range address from the Excel file .

name: Color
label: Color
description: Set Color value add to be an specified excel file

name: Response
label: Response
description: Returns the details of the set color ranged cell in the worksheet.

name: StatusCode
label: Status Code
description: Returns the HTTP status code from the Excel API after read value from the set color range cell in the Excel file.

name: Message
label: Message
description: Returns the HTTP status message from the Excel API read value from the set color ranged cell in the Excel file.
